_comment: Exercises cfgfiles.c cnf_line_HACKDIR(), cnf_line_LEVELDIR(), cnf_line_SAVEDIR(), cnf_line_BONESDIR(), cnf_line_DATADIR(), cnf_line_SCOREDIR(), cnf_line_LOCKDIR(), cnf_line_CONFIGDIR() and cnf_line_TROUBLEDIR() (639-758), which on this build only note the statement and accept it silently; cnf_line_QT_TILEWIDTH(), cnf_line_QT_TILEHEIGHT(), cnf_line_QT_FONTSIZE() and cnf_line_QT_COMPACT() (1240-1291), accepted without Qt; and cnf_line_dogname() (779-782), whose name farlook then shows on the pet dog. The variation spells each directory keyword by its four- or five-letter abbreviation (the cnf_line table's minimum lengths) and dogname as DOGNAME.

segments.nethackrc:
OPTIONS=name:Ferro,role:Ranger,race:elf,gender:male,align:chaotic,pettype:dog,!legacy,!tutorial,!splash_screen,!autopickup,!tips
HACK=/srv/games
LEVE=/srv/games/lv
SAVE=/srv/s
BONES=/srv/b
DATA=/srv/d
SCOR=/srv/sc
LOCK=/srv/l
CONF=/srv/c
TROU=/srv/t
QT_TILEWIDTH=24
QT_TILEHEIGHT=24
QT_FONTSIZE=10
QT_COMPACT=0
DOGNAME=Pip of Lantern Hill
